tasks.label: Update admin email
tasks.command: docker exec irtdp-postgres psql -U irtdp -d irtdp -c "UPDATE users SET email = 'admin@irtdp.com' WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';"

tasks.label: Restart incident-service
tasks.command: docker compose stop incident-service && docker compose up -d incident-service

tasks.label: Check admin user
tasks.command: docker exec irtdp-postgres psql -U irtdp -d irtdp -c "SELECT email FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@irtdp.com';"

tasks.label: Insert admin user
tasks.command: docker exec irtdp-postgres psql -U irtdp -d irtdp -c "INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, role, display_name) VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001','admin@irtdp.com', '$2a$10$cBm7eak8VnbRYJxRUNV2TeNtpaNK8jeJCL7IZbjlqgvCtFHSw8Mim','admin','Platform Admin') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email;"

tasks.label: Restart incident-service
